items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Because after that, Oro took over you know. / No I don't remember of anybody else outside of Oro and George.

ctx.x: Yeah he was with him in Chicago for a while, I know he played with him up there. I don't know if he was…
Because after that, Oro took over you know.
Well I was going to ask some more about the Bakke family. We were talking yesterday about that Zule, Bakke too. He was a younger brother of George.
